title: KNOW-048 real HTTP cache and controlled tenant lifecycle

assertionSteps.title: 1. Given Alice uses an isolated browser profile with the synthetic identity and permissions defined for this case
2. And Alice has catalog permission for the synthetic tile with exact title "T-CACHE"
3. And The browser holds V1 tile data for trade "TR-1001"
4. And The controlled V2 entry request fails during refresh
5. And The V2 fixture uses trade "TR-1002" with distinct field values
6. When Alice reloads the browser page containing the portal
7. And Alice clicks the text "New Tile" on the portal workspace page
8. Then the drawer panel headed by "Tile Options" is visible on the portal workspace page
9. When Alice clicks the text "T-CACHE" in the drawer panel headed by "Tile Options"
10. Then No rendered trade combines V1 identifier "TR-1001" with V2 field values
11. And The agreed load-failure state is visible when no consistent build can render

annotations.description: Actual current React shell and real Chromium HTTP cache. Local HTTP fixture server supplies synthetic Alice, permissions, base entry wrapper, container, tile, trade, lazy content, CSS and images. V1/V2 markers identify controlled fixture assets. No browser routing, production CDN, real business tenant, or changed base binary acceptance.

limits: The recorded assertions and environment binding limit the supported business result.
